preconditions: 0x004DCBA0: 'this' points to a texture/rendering object whose prior state is valid to clear; when a3 is nonzero a texture source (a3) and optional registration token (a10) must be supplied.

0x004DDAD0: a1 (pit-crew context) must be non-null; this+0 carries a base directory string, this+972/this+984 carry team/track config strings, this+980 anchors a linked list whose node strings are compared against the TrackName config.
0x004F8D70: resolution globals dword_8B8DD4/dword_8B8DD8 must be initialized; font path override dword_5EC408 may be null (fallback byte_5EA438); 'this' must be a writable HUD widget slot.

0x004FA320: called once from Game_Init (0x0042D6B0); rendering/audio config globals (dword_7CFB90, dword_7CFBFC, dword_7CFC20, dword_7CF65C, dword_7D032C) already parsed; dword_8AC48C/dword_8AC490 identify the current scene record.
0x004FAC00: called once from Game_Post (0x0042DA30); dword_8AFE88 may hold a live mutex/semaphore handle; the scene record at 396 * dword_8AC48C + dword_8AC490 may be null.
postconditions: 0x004DCBA0: returns 1 when a texture was created or the fallback object was constructed; returns 0 otherwise. On success the prior state was cleaned and this[1] holds an allocated 96-byte child with bit 0 of its +68 dword set.

0x004DDAD0: builds and registers texture paths for the 9 pit-crew/vehicle texture types; frees the temporary path buffer, the TrackName area buffers, and releases the lookup handle before returning. Returns void; null a1 is a no-op.

0x004F8D70: 'this' fields 0x0..0x28 initialized; this+0x0 set to 2 (active) only when the Font.MAS lookup and FTFRAMERATE.BMP surface load both succeed; a 76-byte backing sub-object stored at this+0x18; returns 0.

0x004FA320: returns 0 on success; returns 1 on audio-engine init failure (CUBE error logged). On success: byte_8AFE70 cleared, render flags set per dword_7CFB90, season/track dirs registered in the string registry, the render callback registered then cleared, and dword_8AFE88 holds the initialized audio engine handle.

0x004FAC00: frame-rate counter dword_8AFCA8 reset; mutex handle dword_8AFE88 released and nulled; a global flag reset; the active scene directory path (when a scene exists) trimmed and registered. Returns the StringMatchWithFlagSet result, or 0 when no scene is active.
side_effects: 0x004DCBA0 allocates a 96-byte zero-filled child object (this[1]), ORs bit 0 into its +0x44 dword, may create a D3D texture, may construct a fallback object, and unregisters a local list node and re-runs ResourceCleanup on success.

0x004DDAD0 mutates the string registry (StringRegistry) with the team-mass key, the TrackName load, and the resolved per-variant texture paths; reads the base directory, team/track config strings, and the track-name-matched linked-list node; allocates and frees heap buffers.

0x004F8D70 writes the whole HUD widget prefix (offsets 0x0..0x28, byte 0x2C), registers a font path, loads Font.MAS and FTFRAMERATE.BMP, and positions the frame-rate text; allocates a 76-byte backing object.

0x004FA320 mirrors config globals into render/audio flag globals, registers track-scene and season path strings, registers then clears a render init callback, initializes the audio engine into dword_8AFE88, and sets a subsystem-initialized flag on success.
0x004FAC00 resets the frame-rate counter, releases and nulls the mutex handle dword_8AFE88, resets a global flag, and registers the active scene directory path in the string registry.

external_dependencies.name: CRT string helpers (strlen/strcpy-family loops, sprintf-style %s%s formatting)

disputes.description: Aggregate signature is declared 'thiscall', but per-function conventions differ: 0x004DCBA0 and 0x004F8D70 are __thiscall, 0x004DDAD0 is __fastcall, 0x004FA320 and 0x004FAC00 are unlabeled (cdecl, no parameters). The schema permits one convention, so the mix is documented here rather than resolved by guessing.

Owner classes (TextureRenderObject, PitCrewTexturePathsBuilder, FrameRateHudWidget, VideoManager) are DERIVED from callee families and global usage, not proven by any constructor, vtable, or RTTI evidence in the packet. They must be treated as proposals until reconciliation.

DirectX and audio boundaries are only inferred from callee names (D3DTextureCreation 0x00550080, AudioEngineInitialization 0x00546010, FontSurfaceLookupDispatch 0x0053D260); the packet carries empty import_evidence. Only the CRT string-format usage is directly evidenced in raw C.
